conclusion: g_soft is DECOUPLED from bound fraction (corr -0.10): it saturates at the onset of binding (bf=0.02, g_soft~5e-5 mN/m, +3000x over the pre-binding baseline) and stays flat as bound fraction rises 8.2x. Heads ARE bound and loaded (F/F_stall~0.21 steady) but their per-head force does NOT aggregate into network tension. Binding fraction/rate/measurement-timescale is NOT the lever. The wall is FORCE AGGREGATION (sustained network stress) -- the second floor STAGE-2's head-tension note suspected. Separately, binding itself plateaus at bf~0.16 (< naive 0.38). The proposed batch_steps fix is therefore NOT adopted.
